ios.desc:
What's That? — Your AI Pocket Guide to Anything
You're in a new place. A square with centuries of history. A painting that feels like it's looking back at you. Street food you've never tried. A sign you can't read. Everywhere you look, there's a story waiting—you just need someone to tell it.

What's That? turns your camera into an instant guide. Snap a photo of anything, and within seconds you'll have a real-time, AI-generated narrative explaining what you're looking at—and why it matters. Read it on your screen or listen as an audio guide while you keep exploring.

BUILT FOR TRAVELERS
When you travel, your eyes should be on the world, not on your screen. What's That? is designed for exploration on the move—satisfy your curiosity about what you're seeing without stopping to read Wikipedia articles or scroll through search results.

See something interesting? Snap a photo. The story starts streaming immediately. Generate an audio guide and slip your phone back in your pocket. Keep walking, keep looking, keep discovering.

No tour group schedules. No guidebook baggage. Just you, your camera, and every story the city has to offer.

HOW IT WORKS
Take a photo of anything that catches your eye
Watch the story stream in with elegant, real-time AI analysis
Set your preferences—what kind of details matter most to you?
Tap to generate an audio guide and listen while you walk
Build a beautiful collection of everything you've discovered

PERSONALIZED TO HOW YOU EXPLORE
Not everyone sees the world the same way. Some want the history, the ideas, the "why." Others want the human stories—who built this, who lived here, who's still coming back. Some are drawn to design and craftsmanship. Others like to use their senses and soak in the experience of being there.

Tell us which you care about most, and every story adapts:

A Terracotta Warrior — You might learn about Qin military ranks, or you might hear about the craftsmen who shaped each face by hand
A bowl of ramen in Tokyo — You might get the regional history of tonkotsu, or you might get the sensory breakdown: the richness of the broth, the snap of the noodles
A narrow alley in Marrakech — You might learn about the medina's trade routes, or you might hear about the spices, leather, and footsteps on stone

Over time, the app learns what you love—and your discoveries become unmistakably yours.

AUDIO GUIDES FOR ANYTHING
Your phone becomes a walking tour. Point your camera at a landmark, artwork, street food, or anything
